acceptanceCriteria: Lane charters create checkouts with `git worktree add` from a shared repository and reuse one clean worktree per lane, not a full clone per check.
After a lane's PR merges, its checkouts and scratch are removed; checkouts still used by an active lane are never removed.
A one-off cleanup of merged lanes' checkouts is done with the before/after count and free disk retained; the go-build trim is handled under V1-0360.
body: Evidence: owner-requested audit on 2026-10-17 of orchestrator session 03e2afac (Handoff 2026-10-14): 206 Claude Code lane subagents, 374 lane-hours over 77 h wall. Measured from subagent transcripts under ~/.claude/projects/-Users-russelllewis-projects-corvint/03e2afac-.../subagents (tool_use to tool_result timestamps) and live host reads. Toolchain: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.615, Go 1.27.2, macOS 12-core/64 GB host. Lanes made 498 clone/worktree-add calls (9.5 h). Live host read 2026-10-17: 1,091 git checkouts under /private/tmp (maxdepth 6), ~/Library/Caches/go-build 81 GB, data volume 96% used (89 GiB free), fseventsd at about 60% CPU for 6 days. Expected: each lane uses `git worktree add` from one shared object store, reuses one clean worktree for its checks, and removes its checkouts and scratch once its PR merges. Related: V1-0360 (bounded Go cache trim).
title: Lane checkouts are never removed: 1,091 git checkouts in /private/tmp, 81 GB go-build cache, disk 96% full
